description: Looking to add some extra storage to your home? Check out this utility stand from the Edge Water® collection. Find room for all your random do-dads and knick-knacks in the storage drawer that opens and closes on smooth metal runners. There is also a large adjustable shelf behind the doors for hidden storage of your most prized possessions. Finished in an eye catching Chalked Chestnut®, this stand will get you organized and look great doing it.
